# Browser font regression fixture

`codex-cjk-fixture.ttf.b64` is a base64-encoded TrueType font used only by
`tests/test_cjk_font_pixel_regression.py`.

The fixture is an original, deliberately tiny font. It contains one CJK
character (`U+4E00`) with a distinctive triangle outline and a square
`.notdef` glyph. It contains no third-party font data and is released under
the [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)
dedication.
